description: Source code implementing input file parsing functions for transport security state, including JSON and certificate file parsing, with classes and functions related to certificate validation, pinsets, and JSON configuration handling.

classes.name: CertificateParserState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the states of the certificate parsing state machine.

classes.name: Pinset
classes.description: Class representing a set of pinned public key hashes, with methods to add hashes and register pinsets.

classes.name: TransportSecurityStateEntry
classes.description: Class representing an entry in the transport security state, including hostname, policies, and pinning info.

methods.name: IsImportantWordInCertificateName
methods.description: Checks if a given word is considered important in a certificate name.

methods.name: FilterName
methods.description: Removes all characters not matching [A-Za-z0-9_] from a name and converts to lowercase.

methods.name: MatchCertificateName
methods.description: Determines if a pin name reasonably matches a certificate name based on various heuristics.

methods.name: IsValidName
methods.description: Validates if a candidate name starts with an uppercase letter and contains only allowed characters.

methods.name: ParseCertificatesFile
methods.description: Parses a certificate file input, extracting certificate hashes and timestamps, and populates pinsets.

methods.name: ParseJSON
methods.description: Parses HSTS and pinning configuration JSON strings, populating entries and pinsets.
